# Nephro Decisions

> 台灣腎臟科臨床決策知識庫。由腎臟科專科醫師主導，AI 輔助文獻研究與多輪交替審稿。不接受藥廠贊助、無廣告、無 affiliate。

## Core Clinical Decision Notes

- [SGLT2i Decision Notes](https://nephrodecisions.com/sglt2i/): 20 clinical decision questions on SGLT2 inhibitors in CKD — initiation, monitoring, hold/restart, special populations. Based on KDIGO 2024, DAPA-CKD, EMPA-KIDNEY, CREDENCE.
- [GLP-1 RA Decision Notes](https://nephrodecisions.com/glp1ra/): 10 clinical decision questions on GLP-1 receptor agonists in CKD — FLOW trial, sequencing with SGLT2i, Taiwan NHI coverage.
- [Finerenone Decision Notes](https://nephrodecisions.com/finerenone/): 11 clinical decision questions — mechanism, hyperkalemia management, FIDELIO/FIGARO/FIDELITY evidence, Taiwan NHI status.
- [CKM Syndrome Decision Notes](https://nephrodecisions.com/ckm/): 15 clinical decision questions on Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic syndrome — AHA 2023 staging, cardiorenal syndrome types, four-pillar integration, CV risk stratification.
- [Primary Aldosteronism (PA) Decision Notes](https://nephrodecisions.com/pa/): 13 clinical decision questions on primary aldosteronism in Taiwan nephrology practice — screening, ARR cutoff & washout, confirmatory testing, AVS lateralization, surgery vs MRA, CKD-PA, post-treatment monitoring, adrenal incidentaloma, PA + atrial fibrillation, persistent post-treatment hypertension, NHI coverage, PA + osteoporosis, MACS-PA overlap. Based on 2025 Endocrine Society, 2024 ESC HTN, 2025 Taipei Positional Paper, TAIPAI.

## Patient Education

- [Sexual Health & Kidney Disease](https://nephrodecisions.com/sexual-health/): 22 articles on sexual function, fertility, and intimacy for dialysis and transplant patients. Dual-path design (patient vs clinician).
- [Patient Guides](https://nephrodecisions.com/patient/): Plain-language guides for CKD patients and families — SGLT2i basics, sick day rules, surgery prep, dialysis readiness, primary aldosteronism (PA) patient hub.
- [Dialysis Nursing Education](https://nephrodecisions.com/dialysis/): 10 nursing-oriented dialysis care modules — vascular access, complications, nutrition, CKD-MBD, infection control.

### Patient Video Series (self-hosted, silent, text-on-screen)

- [護腎行動系列 / Kidney Action](https://nephrodecisions.com/patient/kidney-action-series/): 5 short videos on recognizing early CKD — hub + EP1-EP5.
- [SGLT2i 心腎保護系列](https://nephrodecisions.com/patient/sglt2i-series/): 10 short videos explaining SGLT2 inhibitors before discussing them with your physician — hub + EP1-EP10.
- [PA 衛教影片系列](https://nephrodecisions.com/patient/pa-series/): 5 short videos on primary aldosteronism, from whether to screen through post-treatment follow-up — hub + EP1-EP5.
- [PA 病人總覽 / PA Patient Hub](https://nephrodecisions.com/patient/pa-hub/): Primary aldosteronism explained for patients — a treatable and frequently missed cause of hypertension.

## Clinical Topics (Blog)

- [DKD Four-Pillar Therapy Guide 2026](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/dkd-four-pillars-2026/): Comprehensive integration of ACEi/ARB + SGLT2i + Finerenone + GLP-1 RA with Taiwan NHI context.
- [Taiwan ESRD 20-Year Trends](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/taiwan-esrd-20y-clinical/): 2000-2022 dialysis epidemiology, mortality, transplant rates.
- [VERVE-102: PCSK9 Base Editing — "New Era" Not Yet Here for CKD](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/verve-102-ckd-new-era/): Critical appraisal of one-shot PCSK9 gene editing and the evidence gaps for kidney patients.
- [KDIGO 2026 Anemia Guideline — 8 Actions for Dialysis Units + Taiwan Practice](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/kdigo-2026-anemia-taiwan/): Immediately adoptable changes with Taiwan NHI context.
- [Diabetes Insipidus: Central (AVP-D) vs Nephrogenic](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/cdi-avp-d-vs-ndi/): Differentiating central (AVP-deficiency, AVP-D) from nephrogenic DI — water deprivation + desmopressin test, hypernatremia risk, sodium monitoring during treatment.
- [Acquired Nephrogenic DI — AQP2 Loss](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/acquired-ndi-aqp2-loss/): Shared final mechanism (collecting-duct AQP2 downregulation) across lithium, obstruction, endotoxin, hypokalemia, and hypercalcemia.
- [Taiwan Cardiology Workforce Distribution](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/taiwan-cardiology-workforce-rural-access/): Cardiology density is adequate nationally but heart-failure teams are concentrated; institutional analysis from a nephrologist's perspective.
- [Rural Hospital Recruitment: Nephrology or Cardiology?](https://nephrodecisions.com/blog/rural-hospital-nephrology-vs-cardiology-recruitment/): Clinical necessity and recruitment difficulty are two different questions, with explicit falsifiable conditions.

## Rural Nephrology

- [Rural Nephrology Series](https://nephrodecisions.com/rural-nephrology/): District-hospital nephrology in rural southern Taiwan — scope and referral boundaries for CKD, HD/PD, AKI, transplant shared care, and conservative / end-of-life kidney care.
- [Where Are Taiwan's Nephrologists?](https://nephrodecisions.com/rural-nephrology/02-nephrology-workforce-distribution/): National nephrologist density is not low, but county-level averages hide rural gaps — why the county is the wrong unit of analysis.

## Regulatory Watch

- [Taiwan Drug & Device Regulatory Weekly](https://nephrodecisions.com/regulatory/): Weekly digest of TFDA recalls, approvals, and safety actions relevant to nephrology. Physician-reviewed before publication; unreviewed drafts are noindexed and excluded from listings/RSS.

## Trust & Editorial

- [Editorial Policy](https://nephrodecisions.com/editorial-policy/): 7-step production workflow, AI transparency, evidence standards, version management, conflict of interest disclosure.
- [About / Author](https://nephrodecisions.com/about/): Nephrologist, internist, National Taiwan University School of Medicine.

## Key Facts

- Language: Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant), Taiwan context
- Author: 小鎮醫生 (pen name), board-certified nephrologist and internist
- AI usage: Three-source triangulation (ChatGPT + Claude + Gemini) for literature review; physician makes all clinical judgments
- Evidence sources: PubMed/PMID, ClinicalTrials.gov/NCT, KDIGO, ADA, AHA, ESC, TFDA, Taiwan NHI
- Drug names: Generic names primary; Taiwan brand names (e.g., Forxiga/福適佳, Jardiance/恩排糖, Kerendia, Ozempic/胰妥讚) listed for identification only, not endorsement
- No pharma sponsorship, no advertising, no affiliate links
- Last updated: 2026-08-23
